items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: because I worked for 22 years off and on with Eddie Garner

ctx.x: that Wild Bill Davison was going to take, and I still do to this day. That's why he enjoys me working behind him -- because I just won't let him up.

But that band never had a bad moment in two or three years that I was playing down there off and on. This was downtown -- because I worked for 22 years off and on with Eddie Garner, which we'll get into later. But that band -- Bill and I are the only two people alive out of that one. For people who went there and felt and heard it -- and it was well known at the time -- we made a beautiful thing together. We made two albums for Columbia, I think you know -- they were picked two of the greatest all time jazz…

And we had two bands then, Eddie Condon -- used the house band for one set of a half hour for awhile, and then he'd switch over, and the guests would play, like Bill Butterfield, Bud Freeman -- do you understand what I'm getting at?
